gaps.why_now: Current master still does not materialize the older shared Phase 13 build packet, so the ruleset lane needs a direct helper-local replay instead of pretending the wider shared replay surface is already back.

Current master ships a bounded Landlock ruleset helper lab for ruleset-creation planning, handled-access unioning, per-layer mask initialization, rule unmasking, insert_rule() planning, tree search, tree link, and matched-rule replacement planning without claiming live Landlock mutation.

A dedicated direct replay keeps the shipped helper-local ruleset packet machine-checkable around the explicit tree-link and pre-rb_replace_node() replacement planners without widening into live tree mutation.
The current packet checker keeps the shared Phase 13 contributor and ownership surfaces fail-closed around the ruleset lane while the direct replay records the helper-local ruleset boundary.
The current helper packet does not perform actual rb_replace_node() mutation, live rb-tree storage updates, or node ownership transfer; it stays at explicit planning only.

The current helper packet does not model hierarchy allocation, domain merge semantics, or deferred-free lifetime ownership, so hierarchy allocation and live policy state remain outside this bounded ruleset lane.
